name: GM CCA - Jacksonville Parts Distribution Center, Jacksonville FL

fieldNotes.facility: 363,041 SF spec distribution building on a 22.45-acre parcel at 12751 Gran Bay Pkwy W in the master-planned Flagler Center (Mandarin/Southside submarket), immediately off I-95. Listed as General Motors Service Parts Operations; GM CCA parts processing/distribution is run here through 3PL Saddle Creek Logistics (dedicated Jacksonville-Gran Bay facility). Resolved via Yelp/LoopNet/Saddle Creek listings, confirmed against satellite + 2024 Street View.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate. West frontage on Gran Bay Pkwy is an open campus-style office/parking front (glass curtain wall, palm-tree landscaping, open lot - confirmed in Street View). Dock yard on the east face is open paved apron reached by an internal drive with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or fence line. Set false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any approach. The only freestanding structure near the dock-yard entrance is a circular utility/retention tank pad, not a guard booth. Set false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate present, so no remote check-in either. Set false.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Single long dock bank runs the full ~1,000 ft east/northeast face of the building with a regular rhythm of doors and ~28 trailers backed in across the captured imagery; estimated ~38 doors -> 25-50 band. Count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated trailer-storage lot. Trailers are backed into the dock apron (active staging); only an occasional trailer parked in the south-end paved lot (otherwise a car park). Set 0-10.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No separate trailer-storage yard - the narrow tree-lined apron between this building and the neighboring warehouse holds only the active dock-staged trailers. Set false.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal dock drive runs the length of the building and easily holds a 3+ truck queue; entry is from the campus loop road. Set drivewayLong true.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: No gate to bypass; open ungated apron, so no express-lane opportunity in the gate sense. Set false.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: All dock doors are on a single building face (one continuous bank); no physically separate ship/receive clusters. Set false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the 1,022-acre Flagler Center business park off I-95 with dense surrounding office, warehouse, apartment, and retail development in suburban Jacksonville -> Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; nearest intermodal is offsite. Set false.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single distribution building on the parcel (office front + warehouse are one structure). Adjacent warehouses are separate parcels/tenants. Set false.
